sql:
SELECT L.Date, Y.Age 
FROM Laboratory AS L 
JOIN (
    SELECT P.ID, P.Birthday, P.`First Date`, strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
    WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
    ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
    LIMIT 1
) AS Y ON L.ID = Y.ID
ORDER BY L.Date DESC
LIMIT 1
